response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, f.articount AS artifact_count, 1.0 * f.articount / t.artifact_total AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.site_code, s.artifact_count, s.share, s.share - m.average_share AS share_difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
